segments.description: Provides end-to-end customized freight logistics services, with historical specialization in the global steel industry, to industrial and commercial clients.
segments.evidence: management has performed a formal, documented assessment of ASC 280 criteria and concluded that the Company operates under one single reportable operating segment, focused on providing freight logistics services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for coordinated freight logistics services, including ocean freight booking, inland transportation, and delivery, primarily in China.
revenueModel.evidence: For loading/discharging agency services, we received the total payment from our customers in U.S. dollars and paid the port charges on behalf of our customers in RMB.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company disposed of its commodity trading subsidiary New Energy Tech Limited.
changes.evidence: On September 25, 2025, the Company entered into a share transfer agreement with a third party and disposed its subsidiary, New Energy Tech Limited, for a consideration of $2.7 million.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company dissolved its Texas joint venture Brilliant Warehouse Service Inc.
